newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield at Indian 364-day t-bill at 8.45 percent.
newsitem.headline: Yield at Indian 364-day t-bill at 8.45 percent.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 92.23 rupees at an auction of 364-day treasury bills on Wednesday.
Dealers said the yield worked out to 8.45 percent.
The RBI said it received 74 bids for 25.68 billion rupees of which it accepted 34 for 9.58 billion rupees.
Devolvement on primary dealers in fulfilment of their underwriting commitment, amounted to 649.1 million rupees.
The face value of the bills issued amounted to 10.23 billion rupees, the RBI said.
The weighted average cut-off rate was 92.28 rupees.
